description: Stadt Zürich (City of Zürich, Geomatik + Vermessung and Statistik Stadt Zürich) publishes the geodata of the city heritage-conservation inventory, prepared for the city geoserver as CSV, GeoPackage, GeoJSON, shapefile and DXF, listing inventoried buildings and objects of the municipal heritage office; a cantonal dataset of listed monuments (Denkmalschutzobjekte) is published on the same portal. Coverage: the City of Zürich; the portal record was last modified on 2026-09-29. Format and access: CSV, DXF, GPKG, JSON, Shapefile, WFS, WMS, WMTS, downloadable without registration from the City of Zürich open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons CCZero; cost: free. Caveats: the portal description only refers to the source attribute dataset for the content, so what the inventory contains and how many objects it lists were not confirmed; the inventory is not the same as the legal list of protected objects. Simulation uses: heritage-asset exposure layers for flood, fire and earthquake risk studies, and to flag buildings with retrofit constraints in energy and adaptation models. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
